# SalaryTools

> SalaryTools (https://salary.socialninjas.in) is a free, high-performance US payroll, tax, and salary calculation platform. Built and maintained by Nazim and Social Ninja's AI Agency, SalaryTools provides instant, client-side paycheck estimates, hourly-to-salary conversions, state-by-state income tax breakdowns, and 20 comprehensive tax and career guides.

## Core Capabilities

- **Hourly to Salary Converter**: Convert any hourly wage ($10–$250+/hr) into exact daily, weekly, biweekly, semi-monthly, and annual earnings with custom overtime (1.5×, 2×, 2.5×) and paid time off (PTO) adjustments.
- **US Take-Home Pay & Net Salary Calculator**: Calculate net paychecks after Federal Income Tax (2025/2026 progressive IRS brackets), FICA payroll taxes (6.2% Social Security up to wage base + 1.45% Medicare + 0.9% Additional Medicare), and local state income taxes across all 50 US states.
- **50-State Income Tax Engine**: Covers no-income-tax states (Texas, Florida, Washington, Nevada, Alaska, Wyoming, South Dakota, Tennessee, New Hampshire) through progressive tax states (California up to 13.3%, New York up to 10.9%, Hawaii, New Jersey).
- **1,500+ Programmatic State & Job Career Benchmarks**: State-specific median salary, tax deductions, and take-home pay comparisons for 30 high-demand professions (Software Engineers, Registered Nurses, Project Managers, Accountants, etc.).
- **Privacy-First (Zero Server Logging)**: All tax calculations occur client-side in the user's browser. No salary data, SSNs, or personal earnings are ever transmitted to or stored on servers.

## Key Calculation Formulas

- **Annual Salary**: `Hourly Rate × Hours/Week × Weeks/Year` (Standard: 40 hrs/wk × 52 weeks = 2,080 hours)
- **FICA Social Security**: `6.2%` on gross income up to `$176,100` (2025 cap)
- **FICA Medicare**: `1.45%` on all earnings + `0.9%` additional Medicare tax on income over `$200,000` (single) or `$250,000` (married)
- **Net Paycheck**: `Gross Pay - Federal Tax - State Tax - FICA - Pre-Tax Deductions (401k/HSA/FSA)`
